name: YuE
description: YuE2: frontier music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic music editing.
one_liner: AI that composes and produces full songs — lyrics, melody, and instrumentation — from a text prompt or short reference, and can even remix existing songs from scratch.
buyer: A content creator, indie game studio, or ad agency that needs original background music on demand without paying licensing fees or hiring a composer.
business_use_cases: A YouTuber or podcaster generates a unique royalty-free track for every episode instead of buying stock music.
A small game studio generates adaptive soundtrack variations without budget for a composer.
An ad agency mocks up several music styles for a client pitch before commissioning a real composer for the final track.

money_ideas.idea: Sell themed, royalty-free generated music packs on a stock-music marketplace
Offer an 'unlimited custom tracks' subscription for content creators

steal_this: This weekend, generate a themed royalty-free music pack (e.g. 'lo-fi coding music') and list it on a stock-music marketplace.
